author: Henrik Ibsen
title: Et dukkehjem
language_note: Norwegian; modernised electronic edition of Ibsen's Danish-Norwegian original
editorial_note: The electronic edition substantially modernises spelling and morphology; it must not be represented as preserving the 1879 orthography.
assembly_note: The listed Runeberg pages are preserved and concatenated in listed order as one work-level corpus source.
processing_note: Visible text extracted from each preserved Runeberg HTML page and concatenated in listed order; entities decoded and block boundaries converted to newlines.
observed_format: UTF-8 plain text assembled from preserved HTML pages
rights_note: Project Runeberg states that it normally publishes Nordic literary works after copyright has expired under a life-plus-70 rule, and that copyright-protected Runeberg editions display an explicit warning; no such warning appears on this Et dukkehjem edition. Henrik Ibsen died in 1906. Independently, Australian Copyright Agency guidance states that published text is out of copyright in Australia when it was published before 1955 and the creator died before 1955. Et dukkehjem was published in 1879 and Ibsen died in 1906, so the underlying literary work is out of copyright in Australia.
